question.text: An NPO seeking government funding must register on which portal maintained by which body?

answer.text: MCA-21 maintained by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs
FCRA Online maintained by the Ministry of Home Affairs
DARPAN portal maintained by NITI Aayog — a national NPO database
SEBI SCORES portal maintained by SEBI

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 1.8.1 (B)(5), the DARPAN portal maintained by NITI Aayog houses the national NPO database. NPOs seeking government funding must register on DARPAN. The Trap: Option A (MCA-21) is the Companies Act filings portal. Option B is FCRA-specific. Option D (SCORES) is SEBI's investor-grievance portal — unrelated to NPO registration. Cross-Exam Context: Cross-links to Ch 11 (Key Regulations). When the SE claims government-grant funding, an SIA should cross-check DARPAN registration status to corroborate.
